rows.note: 通常 is the all-purpose choice for saying that something happens in most cases or as a usual habit.

example.english: I generally get up at seven in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 ziu1 zou2 cat1 dim2 hei2 san1

rows.note: Use 一般嚟講 when making a broad statement without discussing specific details.

example.english: Generally speaking, Hong Kong people like cold drinks.
example.traditional: 一般嚟講，香港人都鍾意飲凍飲。
example.jyutping: jat1 bun1 lai4 gong2 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 jam2 dung3 jam2

rows.note: Use 普遍 mainly before verbs such as 認為 to say that a view or fact is widely held or known.

example.english: This film is generally considered quite good.
example.traditional: 普遍認為呢套戲幾好睇。
example.jyutping: pou2 bin3 jan6 wai4 ni1 tou3 hei3 gei2 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use 一概 when the statement applies uniformly in every case, without exceptions.

example.jyutping: bun2 dim3 jat1 koi3 bat1 zip3 sau6 teoi3 fo3
